svg.title: Where a buyer's payment goes
svg.desc: Each sale pays the whole price in USDC into your payout contract, which is made from your wallet's address and has no owner. One payout transaction, sent by you at any time or by Agentify when it collects its own share, pays out every sale since the last payout through the shared 0xSplits warehouse: 99.9 percent to your wallet, and 0.1 percent kept in the warehouse for Agentify. Any refund or another remedy is arranged by the merchant with the buyer, outside Agentify. Merchant closure records only the end of future Agentify fulfillment.
